G1200.def:
δεσμο-φύλαξ, -κος, ὁ
(δεσμός, φύλαξ),
a prison-keeper, gaoler: At 16:23, 27, 36 (cf. ἀρχιδ-, Gn 39:21).†
(AS)

G1201.def:
δεσμωτήριον, -ου, τό
[in LXX for בֵּית סֹהַר (Ge), אָסִיר ;]
a prison: Mt 11:2, At 5:21, 23 16:26.†
(AS)

G1202.def:
δεσμώτης, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for אסר, מַסְגֵּר ;]
a prisoner: At 27:1, 42.†
(AS)

G1203.def:
δεσπότης, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for אָדוֹן, אֲדֹנָי; in Jdth.9:17, δ. τ. οὐρανῶν κ. τ. γῆς];
a master, lord, correlative of δοῦλος, οἰκέτης: 1Tm 6:1, 2, 2Tm 2:21, Tt 2:9, 1Pe 2:18; as title of God, voc., δέσποτα (so usually in LXX), Lc 2:29, At 4:24; ὁ δ. = voc. δέσποτα (cf. B1., § 33, 4), Ap 6:10; of Christ, 2Pe 2:1, Ju 4, R, txt. (but cf. mg.).†
SYN.: κύριος (which see), implying limitation of authority and a more general relation than δ., which "denoted absolute ownership and uncontrolled power" (Thayer). (AS)

G1204.def:
δεῦρο
adv., [in LXX chiefly for לֵךְ, לֵכָה ;]
__1. of place;
__(a) hither, with verbs of motion;
__(b) (in cl. chiefly poët.) as an imperat., here! come!: Mt 19:21, Mc 10:21, Lc 18:22, Jo 11:43, At 7:3" (LXX) , 34 (LXX), Ap 17:1 21:9.
__2. Of time, hitherto, now: Ap 1:13.†
(AS)

G1205.def:
δεῦτε
adv., as pl. of δεῦρο, 1. (b), which see, [in LXX chiefly for לְכוּ ;]
come on! come here! come!: with imperat., Mt 25:34 28:6, Jo 4:29 21:12, Ap 19:17; with subjc., Mt 21:38, Mc 12:7; before ὀπίσω, Mt 4:19, Mc 1:17; πρός, Mt 11:28; εἰς, Mt 22:4, Mc 6:31.†
(AS)

G1206.def:
δευτεραῖος, -α, -ον
(δεύτερος),
adj. with adverbial sense;
on the second day: δευτεραῖοι ἤλθομεν, At 28:13.†
(AS)

G1207.def:
δευτερό-πρωτος, -ον
second first (in what sense, there is no satisfactory explanation. The reading is prob. not original, see ICC, in l.; DCG, i, 411; ii, 541, 724): Lc 6:1, WH, mg., R, mg.†
(AS)

G1208.def:
δεῦτερος, -α, -ον,
second in order, with or without idea of time: Mt 22:26, 39, al.; θάνατος, Ap 2:11 20:14 21:8; χάρις, 2Co 1:15. In neut. as adv., secondly, a second time; opposite to πρῶτον: Jo 3:4 21:16, 1Co 12:28, Ap 19:3; τὸ δ., 2Co 13:2, Ju 5; ἐν τ. δ., at the second time: At 7:13; in later usage (as 1Ma.9:1), ἐκ δ., Mc 14:72, Jo 9:24, At 11:9, Hb 9:28.
(AS)

G1209.def:
δέχομαι, depon. mid.,
[in LXX chiefly for לקח ;]
to receive, accept;
__1. with accusative of thing(s), of taking or accepting what is offered: γράμματα, Lc 16:6, 7; id. in different sense, At 28:21; ποτήριον, Lc 22:17; παιδίον (εἰς τ. ἀγκάλας), Lc 2:28; περικεφαλαίαν, μάχαιραν, Ef 6:17; ἐπιστολάς, At 22:5; τ. βασιλείαν τ. Θεοῦ, Mc 10:15, Lc 18:17; λογία ζῶντα, At 7:38; εὐαγγέλιον, 2Co 11:4; τ. χάριν τ. Θεοῦ, 2Co 6:1; metaphorically, of mental acceptance, Mt 11:14; τ. λόγον, Lc 8:13, At 8:14 11:1 17:11, 1Ts 1:6 2:13, Tg 1:21; τὰ τ. πνεύματος, 1Co 2:14; τ. παράκλησιν, 2Co 8:17; τ. ἀγάπην τ. ἀληθείας, 2Ts 2:10.
__2. with accusative of person(s), of receiving kindly or hospitably, Mt 10:14 40, 41, Mc 6:11, Lc 9:5 53 10:8, 10, Jo 4:45, 2Co 7:15 11:16, Gl 4:14, Cl 4:10, Hb 11:31; παιδίον, Mt 18:5, Mc 9:37, Lc 9:48; εἰς οἴκους, σκηνάς, Lc 16:4, 9; δέξαι τ. πνεῦμά μου, At 7:59; ὃν δεῖ οὐρανὸν δέασθαι, At 3:21 (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο, δια-, εἰσ-, ἐκ-, ἀπ-εκ-, ἐν-, ἐπι-, παρα-, προσ-, ὑπο-δέχομαι; Cremer, 174).†
(AS)

G1210.def:
δέω (I),
[in LXX chiefly for אסר ;]
to tie, bind, fasten;
__(1) with accusative of thing(s), before εἰς δεσμάς, Mt 13:30; of an ass, Mt 21:2, Mc 11:2, 4 Lc 19:30.
__(2) with accusative of person(s), of swathing a dead body, ὀθονίοις, Jo 19:40; δεδομένος τ. πόδας . . . κειρίαις (Bl., §34, 6; Kühner 3, iii, 125), Jo 11:44; of binding with chains, ἀγγέλους, Ap 9:14; a demoniac, πέδαις κ. ἁλύσεσι, Mc 5:3, 4; captives, Mt 12:29 14:3 22:13 27:2, Mc 3:27 6:17 15:1, 7, Jo 18:12, 24, At 9:2, 14, 21, 21:11, 13 22:5, 29 24:27, Cl 4:3, Ap 20:2; ἁλύσεσι, At 12:6 21:33. Metaphorical, ὁ λόγος τ. Θεοῦ, 2Tm 2:9; of Satan binding by disease (MM, see word), Lc 13:16; of constraint or obligation, At 20:22; of the marriage bond, 1Co 7:39; id. with dative of person(s), ἀνδρί, Rm 7:2; γυναικί, 1Co 7:27; in Rabbinic lang. (Dalman, Words, 213f.), to forbid, declare forbidden, Mt 16:19 18:18 (cf. κατα-, περι-, συν-, ὐπο-δέω; Cremer, 82).
† (AS)

G1211.def:
δή
consecutive co-ordinating particle with no exact equiv. in Eng., giving greater exactness and emphasis to the word or words to which it is attached; sometimes translatable as now therefore, then, verily, certainly.
__1. With verbs: imperat., At 6:3 (WH, mg.) 13:2, 1Co 6:20; hort. subjc., Lc 2:15, At 15:36; indic., δή που (Τ, δήπου, which see), Hb 2:16.
__2. With pronouns: ὃ δή, now this is he who, Mt 13:23.†
(AS)

G1212.def:
δῆλος, -η, -ον
[in LXX for אוּר, etc. ;]
__1. visible.
__2. clear to the mind, evident: Mt 26:73; δ. (sc. ἐστίν), before ὅτι, 1Co 15:27, Gl 3:11.†
SYN.: φανερός, with ref. to outward appearance, manifest as opposite to concealed; δ. with ref. to inner perception, evident, known, under­stood. (AS)

G1213.def:
δηλόω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for ידע ;]
to make plain, declare: with accusative, 1Co 3:13, Cl 1:8, Hb 9:8 12:27; with dative of person(s), 2Pe 1:14; with dative of person(s), before περί (pass.), 1Co 1:11; before εἰς, 1Pe 1:11.†
SYN.: ἐμφανίζω, to make manifest, render visible to the sight; δ. to render evident to the mind. (AS)

G1214.def:
Δημᾶς, ὁ
(perh. contracted from Δημήτριος),
Demas, a companion of St. Paul: Cl 4:14, Phm 24, 2Tm 4:10.†
(AS)

G1215.def:
δημηγορέω, -ῶ
(δῆμος, ἀγορεύω, to speak in the assembly), [in LXX: Pv 24:66 (30:31), 4Ma.5:15 * ;]
to deliver an oration: At 12:21.†
(AS)

G1216.def:
Δημήτριος, -ου, ὁ
Demetrius;
__1. a silversmith, At 19:24 38.
__2. A Christian disciple, III Jn 12.†
(AS)

G1217.def:
δημιουργός, -οῦ, ὑ
(δῆμος, ἔργον), [in LXX: 2Ma.4:1 * ;]
__1. one who works for the people.
__2. Univ., an author, builder, maker; the maker of the world (Xen., Mem., I, 4, 9, al.), Hb 11:10.†
SYN.: κτίστης, creator, τεχνίτης, craftsman, designer. In He, l.with, τ. has reference to the plan, δ. to its execution. (AS)

G1218.def:
δῆμος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁפָּחָה ;]
__1. a district, country.
__2. the common people, the people generally; esp. the people assembled: At 12:22 17:5 19:30 33.
† SYN.: λαός, the people at large: δ., the people as a body politic; opposite to δ. is ὄχλος, the unorganized multitude. ἔθνος, in sing., means in NT as in Gk. writers generally, a nation, but in pl. denotes the rest of mankind apart from the Jews: Gentiles. λ. also, rare in cl. (Att... λεώς), is frequently in LXX and NT, and usually limited to the chosen people, Israel (cf. Cl. Rev., i, 42 f.; Cremer, 689). (AS)

G1219.def:
δημόσιος, -α, -ον
(δῆμος), [in LXX: 2Ma.6:10, 3Ma.2:27 4:7 * ;]
belonging to the people, public: At 5:18; dative fem. used adverbially (cl.);
__(a) at the public expense, by public consent;
__(b) publicly: At 16:37 18:28 20:20.†
(AS)

G1220.def:
δηνάριον, -ου, τό
the Lat. denarius, a Roman coin, nearly equal to the δραχμή, which see: Mt 18:28 20:2, 9, 13 22:19, Mc 6:37 12:15 14:5, Lc 7:41 10:35 20:24, Jo 6:7 12:5, Ap 6:6; τὸ ἀνὰ δ., Mt 20:10.†
(AS)

G1221.def:
δή-ποτε
indef. adv. (also written δή ποτε), with generalizing force;
__1. absol., sometime.
__2. With adv. or relat., -soever: ᾦ δ., Jo 5:4 (L, οἱῳδηποτοῦν).†
(AS)

G1223.def:
διά (before a vowel δ᾽, exc. Rm 8:10, 2Co 5:7, and in (Proper name)s; Tdf., Pr., 94),
prep. with genitive, accusative, as in cl.;
__1. with genitive, through;
__(i) of Place, after verbs of motion or action: Mt 2:12 12:43, Mc 2:23, Lc 4:30, Jo 4:4, 2Co 11:33, al.; σώζεσθαι (διας-) δ. πυρός, ὕδατος, 1Co 3:15, 1Pe 3:20; βλέπειν δ. ἐσόπτρου, 1Co 13:12; metaphorically, of a state or condition: Rm 14:20, 2Co 2:4 5:7, 10; δ. γράμματος, ἀκροβυστίας (Lft., Notes, 263, 279), Rm 2:27 4:11; δι ̓ὑπομενῆς, Rm 8:25.
__(ii) Of Time;
__(a) during which: Mt 26:61, Mc 14:58, Lc 5:5; δ. παντὸς τοῦ ζῆν, Hb 2:15; δ. παντός (διαπαντός in Mc 5:5, Lc 24:53), always, continually, Mt 18:10, At 2:25" (LXX) 10:2 24:16, Rm 11:10" (LXX), 2Ts 3:16, Hb 9:6 13:15.
__(b) within which: At 1:3; δ. νυκτός, At 5:19 16:9 17:10 23:31;
__(with) after which (Field, Notes, 20; Abbott, JG, 255f.): Mc 2:1, At 24:17, Gl 2:1.
__(iii) Of the Means or Instrument;
__(1) of the efficient cause (regarded also as the instrument): of God, Rm 11:36, 1Co 1:9, Gl 4:7, Hb 2:10 7:21; of Christ, Rm 1:8 5:1, 17, 1Co 15:21, 1Pe 4:11, al.; δ. τ. ὑμῶν δεήσεως, Rm 1:12, 2Co 1:4, Gl 4:23, al.;
__(2) of the agent, instrument or means;
__(a) with genitive of person(s), Mt 11:2, Lc 1:70, Jo 1:17, At 1:16, Rm 2:16, 1Co 1:21, Ef 1:5, Hb 2:14, Ap 1:1, al.; ὑπὸ τ. κυρίου δ. τ. προφήτου (δ. τ. κυρίου, 1Ts 4:2 (M, Th., in l.); Lft., Rev., 121f.), Mt 1:22 2:15, Rm 1:2; δ. ἐπιστολῆς ὡς δ. ἡμῶν (Field, Notes, 202), 2Ts 2:2; δ. Σ. (NTD, 22), 1Pe 5:12;
__(b) with genitive of thing(s) (where often the simple dative is used in cl.; Jannaris, Gr., 375), Jo 11:4, At 5:12; δ. τ. πίστεως, Rm 3:30; δ. λόγου θεοῦ, 1Pe 1:23; δ. παραβολῆς, Lc 8:4; δουλεύειν δ. τ. ἀγάπης, Gl 5:13; δ. ἐπαγγελίας, Gl 3:18,
__2. C. accusative;
__(i) rarely, as with genitive, through (Hom), δ. μέσον Σαμαρίας (ICC, in l.; Bl., §42, 1; Robertson, Gr., 581), Lc 17:11.
__(ii) by reason of, because of, for the sake of;
__(a) with accusative of person(s) (M, Pr., 105), Mc 2:27, Jo 6:57 11:42, Rm 8:20;
__(b) with accusative of thing(s), δ. φθόνον, Mt 27:18, Mc 15:10; δ. φόβον, Jo 7:13 20:19; δ. ἀγάπην, Ef 2:4; δ. τοῦτο, freq., for this cause, therefore, Mt 6:25, Mc 6:14, Lc 11:49, Jo 6:65, al.; id. before ὅτι, Jo 5:16 10:17, al.; δ. τί, why, Mt 9:11, 14 Mc 2:18, Jo 7:45, al.; δ. τό, with inf., Mc 5:4, Lc 9:7, Tg 4:2.
__3. In composition,
__(1) through, as in διαβαίνω;
__(2) of separation, asunder, as in διασπάω;
__(3) of distribution, abroad, as in διαγγέλλω;
__(4) of transition, as διαλλάσσω;
__(5) of "perfective" action (M, Pr., 112f., 115f.), as διαφύγω, διακαθαρίζω.
(AS)

G1224.def:
δια-βαίνω
[in LXX chiefly for עבר ;]
__1. to make a stride.
__2. to step across, cross over;
__(a) trans.: τ. θάλασσαι, Hb 11:29;
__(b) intrans.: before εἰς, At 16:9; πρός, Lc 16:26.†
(AS)

G1225.def:
δια-βάλλω
[in LXX: Dan LXX 3:8, Da TH 3:8; 6:24 (25) (אֲכַל קְרַץ), 2Ma.3:11, 4Ma.4:1 * ;]
__1. to throw across.
__2. To slander, defame, accuse falsely or maliciously: Lc 16:1 (Cremer, 120).†
(AS)

G1227.def:
δια-βλέπω
__1. to took straight before one.
__2. to see clearly: Mt 7:5, Mc 8:25, Lc 6:42 (cf. διάβλεψις, Aq., Is 61:1, for LXX ἀνάβ-).†
(AS)

G1228.def:
διάβολος, -ον
(διαβάλλω, which see) [in LXX for שָׂטָן (as Jó 1:6), exc. Et 7:4 8:1 (צַר, צָרַר) ;]
slanderous, accusing falsely. As subst., ὁ, ἡ, δ.;
__(a) generally (of. Es, ll. with), a slanderer, false accuser: 1Tm 3:6, 7 (CGT, in l., but see infr.) 3:11, 2Tm 3:3, Tt 2:3;
__(b) as chiefly in LXX, of Satan, the Accuser, the Devil: Mt 4:1, 5, 8, 11 13:39 25:41, Lc 4:2, 3, 6, 13 8:12, Jo 13:2, At 10:38, Ef 4:27 6:11, 1Tm 3:6, 7 (but see supr.), 2Tm 2:26, Hb 2:14, Tg 4:7, 1Pe 5:8, Ju 9, Ap 2:10 12:9, 12 20:2, 10; εἶναι ἐκ τοῦ δ., Jo 8:44, 1Jo 3:8; τέκνα τοῦ δ., 1Jo 3:10; υἱὸς, At 13:10; metaphorically, of Judas, Jo 6:70 (Cremer, 121; DCG, ii, 605).†
(AS)

G1229.def:
δι-αγγέλω
[in LXX for ספר pi., etc. ;]
to publish abroad, proclaim: with accusative, Lc 9:60, At 21:26, Rm 9:17" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G1230.def:
δια-γίνομαι
(Ion. and late Gk. for διαγίγν-), [in LXX, 2Ma.11:26 * ;]
__1. to go through, to pass, e.g. τ. νύκτα; absol., to live.
__2. Of time, to intervene, elapse: ptcp., with ἡμερῶν τινῶν, At 25:13; ἱκανοῦ χρόνου, ib. 27:9; τ. σαβάτου, Mc 16:1.†
(AS)

G1231.def:
δια-γινώσκω
(see previous word), [in LXX chiefly for ידע, and cf. 2Ma.9:15 ;]
__1. to distinguish, ascertain exactly: At 23:15
__2. As Athen. law-term, to determine: τὰ καθ᾽ ὑμᾶς, your case, At 24:22 (Cremer, 673).†
(AS)

G1233.def:
διά-γνωσις, -εως, ἡ
(διαγιγνώσκω), [in LXX: Wis.3:18 * ;]
__1. a distinguishing, also as medical term.
__2. As law-term (Lat. cognitio), determination, decision: At 25:21 (Cremer, 674).†
(AS)

G1234.def:
δια-γογγύζω
[in LXX chiefly for לין, לון, as Êx 16:2, and cf. Si 34(31):24 ;]
of a number, to murmur or mutter among themselves: Lc 15:2 19:7.†
(AS)

G1235.def:
δια-γρηγορέω, -ῶ
__(a) prop., to remain awake (R, mg.);
__(b) to be fully awake (R, txt.): Lc 9:32.†
(AS)

G1236.def:
δι-άγω
[in LXX for עבר hi., etc. ;]
__1. to carry over.
__2. Of time, to pass: βίον, 1Tm 2:2; absol., to live, before ἐν, Tt 3:3.†
(AS)

G1237.def:
δια-δέχομαι
[in LXX for מִשְׁנֶה (Deiss., BS, 115), פַּרְבָּר ;]
to receive through another, receive in turn: At 7:45 (RV, in their turn; see Field, Notes, 116).†
(AS)

G1238.def:
διάδημα, -τος, τό
(διαδέω, to bind round), [in LXX for כֶּתֶר (as Et 1:11), etc. ;]
the band round the τιάρα of a Persian king; a diadem, the badge of royalty: Ap 12:3 13:1 19:12.†
SYN.: στέφανος, the badge of "victory, of valour, of nuptial joy, of festal gladness " (but see M, Th., i, 219; cf. DB, i, 530, 604). (AS)

G1239.def:
δια-διδωμι
[in LXX for חלק pi., etc. ;]
__1. to hand over, deliver: Ap 17:13, Rec.
__2. to distribute: Lc 11:22 18:22, Jo 6:11, At 4:35†
(AS)

G1240.def:
διά-δοχος, -ου, ὁ, ἡ
(διαδέχομαι), [in LXX: 1Cr 18:17 (לְיַד), 2Cr 26:11 (שַׂר) 28:7 (מִשְׁנֶה), Sir.46:1 48:8, 2Ma.4:29 14:26 * ;]
a successor: At 24:27 (for usage in LXX and π. in sense of court official, see Deiss., BS, 115).†
(AS)

G1241.def:
δια-ζώννυμι, (also -ννύω)
[in LXX for חֲגוֹר, Eze.23:15 A * ;]
to gird round: ἑαυτόν, Jo 13:4; pass., ib. 13:5; mid., to gird oneself with: with accusative, Jo 21:7.†
(AS)

G1242.def:
διαθήκη, -ης, ἡ
(διατίθημι), [frequently in LXX, and nearly always for בְּרִית ;]
__1. as usually in cl., a disposition, testament, will (Plat., al.): Gl 3:15 (R, mg., but see Lft., in l.), Hb 9:16, 17 (R, txt.; MM, Exp., xi; Milligan, NTD, 75; Abbott, Essays, 107; Deiss., LAE, 341; but see infr.).
__2. As in LXX (for בְּרִית) = cl. συνθήκη, a convention, arrangement, covenant (exc. in the disputed cases mentioned above, always between God and man, "perhaps with the feeling that the δια- compound was more suitable than the συν- for a covenant with God---συνθ. might suggest equal terms," MM, Exp., l.with): Gl 3:15 (R, txt., but see supr., and cf. Thayer, see word), Hb 9:16, 17 (R, mg., Westc., in l.; Hatch, Essays, 47; but see supr.), Mt 26:28, Mc 14:24, Lc 1:72, At 3:25 7:8, Rm 11:27" (LXX), 2Co 3:14, Gl 3:17, Hb 7:22 8:6, ib. 9, 10" (LXX) 9:4, 15-17 20" (LXX) 10:16 (LXX), 29 12:24 13:20, Ap 11:19; καινὴ δ., Mt 26:28, and Mc 14:24 (R, mg.), Lc 22:20, 1Co 11:25, 2Co 3:6, Hb 8:8" (LXX) 9:15; pl. Rm 9:4, Gl 4:24, Ef 2:12.†
(AS)

G1243.def:
δι-αίρεσις, -εως, ἡ
(διαιρέω), [in LXX chiefly for מַחֲלֹקֶת ;]
__1. a distinction, diference.
__2. a division, distribution: 1Co 12:4-6 (cf. διαιρέω; Cremer, 616).†
(AS)

G1244.def:
δι-αιρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for בּתר (as Gn 15:10), חלק (as Js 18:5), etc. ;]
__1. to divide into parts, cut asunder.
__2. to distribute: with accusative of thing(s), dative of person(s), Lc 15:12, 1Co 12:11.†
(AS)

G1247.def:
διακονέω, ῶ
(δίακονος);
__1. generally, to minister, serre, wait upon, especially at table, to do one a service, cure for one's needs: absol., Mt 20:28, Mc 10:45, Lc 10:40 22:26, 27, Jo 12:2, 1Pe 4:11; ὅσα διηκόνησεν, 2Tm 1:18; with dative of person(s), Mt 4:11 8:15 25:44 27:55, Mc 1:13, 31 15:41, Lc 4:39 8:3 12:37 17:8, Jo 12:26, At 6:2 19:22, Rm 15:25, Phm 13, Hb 6:10.
__2. to serve as deacon: 1Tm 3:10, 3:13.
__3. C. accusative of thing(s), to minister, supply, supply by ministration: 1Pe 1:12 4:10; pass., 2Co 3:3 8:19, 20.†
SYN.: λειτουργέω, which see (Cremer, 179). (AS)

G1248.def:
διακονία, -ας, ἡ
(διάκονος), [in LXX for נַעַר, שָׁרַת pi.: Et 6:3, Et 6:5 A; 1Ma.11:58 * ;]
the office and work of a διάκονος, service, ministry;
__(a) of domestic duties (Field, Notes, 63): Lc 10:40
__(b) spec. of religious ministration, and the exercise of ministerial functions in the Church: At 1:17, 25 6:1, 4 11:29 12:25 20:24; 21:19, Rm 11:13 12:7 15:31, 1Co 16:15, 2Co 4:1 6:3 8:4 9:1, 13, Ef 4:12, Cl 4:17, 1Tm 1:12, 2Tm 4:5, 11, Hb 1:14, Ap 2:19; δ. τ. θανάτου, 2Co 3:7; τ. πνεύματος, 2Co. 3:8; τ. κατακρίσεως, τ, δικαιοσύνης, 2Co. 3:9; τ. καταλλαγῆς, 2Co. 5:18; τ. λειτουργίας, 2Co. 9:12; with obj. genitive, τὴν ὑμῶν δ., ib. 11:8; pl., 1Co 12:5.†
(AS)

G1249.def:
διάκονος, -ου, ὁ, ἡ
(derivation unknown), [in LXX for נַעַר, שָׁרַת pi.: Et 6:3, 5, א B Et 1:10 2:2, Pv 10:4, 4Ma.9:17 * ;]
__1. in general, a servant, attendant, minister: Mt 20:26 22:13 23:11, Mc 9:35 10:43, Jo 2:5, 9, 1Co 3:5, Gl 2:17, Ef 6:21, Cl 4:7; δ. θεοῦ, Rm 13:4, 2Co 6:4, 1Ts 3:2; δ. Χριστοῦ, 2Co 11:23, Cl 1:7, 1Tm 4:6; cf. ὁ δ. ὁ ἐμός, Jo 12:26; δ. περιτομῆς, Rm 15:8; δ. καινῆς διαθήκης, 2Co 3:6; δ. δικαιοσύνης, 2Co 11:15; δ. [εὐαγγελίου], Ef 3:7, Cl 1:23; δ. [ἐκκλησίας], Cl 1:25.
__2. As technical term for Church officer (so in pre-Christian times, see M, Th., I, 32), a deacon: Fp 1:1, 1Tm 3:8, 12; fem. (cf. Eccl. διακονίσσα), Rm 16:1 (cf. 1Tm 3:11, and CGT, in l., also M, Th., l.with).†
SYN.: δοῦλος, bondman; θεράπων, servant acting voluntarily; ὑπηρέτης, servant, attendant, by etymol. suggesting subordination. All these imply relation to a person, in distinction from which δ. represents rather the servant in relation to his work. Cf. also λειτουργός, a public servant, in which the idea of service to the community is prominent; οἰκέτης, a house servant. (AS)

G1251.def:
δι-ακούω
[in LXX: Dt 1:16 (שׁמע), Jó 9:33 (יָד שִׁית hi.)* ;]
to hear through, hear fully; technically, to hear judicially (as De, l.with; of. Deiss., BS, 230): At 23:35.†
(AS)

G1252.def:
δια-κρίνω
[in LXX for שׁפט, דִּין, etc. ;]
__1. to separate, hence, to distinguish, discriminate, discern: μηδὲν δ., At 11:12; οὐδὲν δ. μεταξύ, At 15:9; σε, 1Co 4:7; τὸ σῶμα, 1Co 11:29.
__2. to settle, decide, judge, arbitrate: Mt 16:3, 1Co 6:5 11:29 (ICC, in l.), ib. 31 14:29. Mid, and pass.;
__1. to get a decision, contend, dispute: before πρός, At 11:2; with dative (but see ICC, in l.), Ju 9; absol., Ju 22 (R,mg.).
__2. Hellenistic (NT and Eccl., but not LXX), to be divided in one's mind, to hesitate, doubt: Mt 21:21 Rm 14:23, Tg 1:6; ἐν ἐαυτῷ, Tg 2:4; ἐν τ. καρδίᾳ, Mc 11:23; μηδὲν δ., At 10:20; δ. τ. ἀπιστίᾳ, Rm 4:20, Ju 22 (R, txt.).†
(AS)

G1253.def:
διά-κρισις, -εως, ἡ
(διακρίνω) [in LXX for מִפְלָשׂ, Jó 37:16 * ;]
the act of judgment, discernment: Rm 14:1, 1Co 12:10, Hb 5:14.†
(AS)

G1254.def:
δια-κωλεύω
[in LXX: Jdth.4:7 12:7 * ;]
to hinder, prevent: with accusative, Mt 3:14.†
(AS)

G1255.def:
δια-λαλέω, -ῶ
[in Sm.: Ps 50(51):16, and al. ;]
__1. to talk with: πρός, Lc 6:11.
__2. to talk over: pass., Lc 1:65.†
(AS)

G1256.def:
δια-λέγομαι
(mid. of διαλέγω, to pick out, distinguish, as depon.), [in LXX: Êx 6:27, Is 63:1 (דּבר pi.), Jz 8:1 (ריב), 1Es.8:46, Et 5:2, Sir.14:20, 2Ma.11:20 * ;]
to converse with, discourse (see Cl. Rev., i, 45), discuss, argue: At 18:4 19:8,9 20:9; with dative of person(s), At 17:17 18:19 20:7, Hb 12:5; before πρός, Mc 9:34, At 17:17 24:12; περί At 24:25, Ju 9; ἀπὸ τ. γραφῶν, At 17:2.†
(AS)

G1257.def:
δια-λείπω
[in LXX for יחל (as 1Rs 10:8), etc. ;]
to intermit, leave off for a time: Lc 7:45.†
(AS)

G1258.def:
διά-λεκτος, -ου, ἡ
(διαλέγομαι), [in LXX: Dan LXX 1:4 (לָשׁוֹן), Et 9:26 * ;]
__1. conversation, discourse, speech (Plat., Dem., al.).
__2. As in Polyb. and later writers, the language or dialect of a particular country or district: At 1:19 2:6, 8 21:40 22:2 26:14.†
(AS)

G1259.def:
δι-αλλάσσω
[in LXX: 1Rs 29:4 (רָצָה hithp.), I Et 4:31, al. ;]
__1. to change, exchange.
__2. to change enmity for friendship, to reconcile: pass., with dative of person(s), Mt 5:24. "The word denotes mutual concession after mutual hostility, an idea absent from καταλλ-," which see (Lft., Notes, 288; cf. Deiss., LAE, 178.15; Cremer, 91, 632).†
(AS)

G1260.def:
δια-λογίζομαι, depon.
[in LXX chiefly for חשׁב, frequently in Pss. ;]
__1. to balance accounts (Dem.).
__2. to consider, reason (Isocr.): Lc 1:29 5:21; ἐν τ. καρδία, Mc 2:6, 8, Lc 5:22; περί Lc 3:15; ἐν ἑαυτῷ (-οῖς), Mt 16:7-8, Mc 2:8, Lc 12:17; πρὸς ἑ., Mc 9:33 11:31, Lc 20:14; παρ᾽ ἑ., Mt 21:25 (ἐν ἑ., T, WH, mg.); πρὸς ἀλλήλους, Mc 8:16; ὅτι, Mc 8:17, Jo 11:50, Rec. (DB, i, 611; Cremer, 400).†
(AS)

G1261.def:
δια-λογισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(διαλογίζομαι) [in LXX chiefly for מַחֲשָׁבָה ;]
a thought, reasoning, inward questioning: Mt 15:19, Mc 7:21, Lc 2:35 5:22 6:8 9:46, 47 24:38, Rm 1:21 14:1, 1Co 3:20" (LXX), Fp 2:14; κριταὶ δ. πονηρῶν, genitive of qual. (cf. Pv 12:5), Tg 2:4; χωρὶς ὀργῆς καὶ δ. (where perh. δ., like מְזִמָּה, in Ps 138(139):20, al., implies evil intention), 1Tm 2:8 (see Hort, in l.; cf. Cremer, 400).†
(AS)

G1262.def:
δια-λύω
[in LXX for אבה, חבל, etc. ;]
to part asunder, dissolve; of an assembly, pass., to disperse: At 5:36.†
(AS)

G1263.def:
δια-μαρτύρομαι, depon., of Ionic origin, intensive of the simple μαρτύρομαι, which see,
[in LXX chiefly for עוּד hi., usually with dative of person(s), Dt 4:26 8:19, 1Rs 8:9, al. ;]
solemnly to protest: Lc 16:28, At 2:40 8:25 10:42 18:5 20:21, 23, 24 23:11 28:23, 1Ts 4:6, Hb 2:6; in adjuration, before ἐνώπιον τ. θεοῦ, 1Tm 5:21, 2Tm 2:14 4:1 (Cremer, 415).†
(AS)

G1264.def:
δια-μάχομαι
[in LXX for לחם ni., Dan LXX 10:20; Sir.8:1, 3 38:28 51:19 * ;]
__1. to struggle against.
__2. In argument, to contend: At 23:9.†
(AS)

G1265.def:
δια-μένω
[in LXX for עמד, etc.;]
to remain, continue: Lc 1:22 22:28, Gl 2:5, Hb 1:11" (LXX), 2Pe 3:4.†
(AS)

G1266.def:
δια-μερίζω
[in LXX chiefly for חלק pi. ;]
__1. to distribute: with dative of person(s), At 2:45; before εἰς, Lc 22:17, pass., At 2:3. Mid. to distribute among themselves: Mt 27:35, Mc 15:24, Lc 23:34; with redundant ἑαυτοῖς, Jo 19:24 (LXX) (see M, Pr., 157).
__2. to divide, separate: pass., before ἐπί, with accusative, Lc 11:17-18; ἐπί, with dative, Lc 12:52-53.†
(AS)

G1267.def:
δια-μερισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(διαμερίζω), [in LXX: Eze.48:29 (מַחֲלֹקֶת), Mq 7:12 * ;]
a division: opposite to εἰρήνη, Lc 12:51.†
(AS)

G1268.def:
δια-νέμω
[in LXX for חלק, Dt 29:25 * ;]
to distribute, divide: pass., to be spread about, At 4:17.†
(AS)

G1269.def:
δια-νεύω
[in LXX: Ps 34(35):19 (קרץ), Sir.27:22 * ;]
to wink at, nod to, beckon to: Lc 1:22.†
(AS)

G1270.def:
δια-νόημα, -τος, τό
(διανοέομαι, to think), [in LXX for מַחֲשָׁבָה, etc., Is 55:9, al., frequently in Sir ;]
a thought: Lc 11:17.†
(AS)

G1271.def:
διάνοια, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for לֵב, לֵבָב ;]
the understanding, mind: Lc 1:51, Ef 4:18, Cl 1:21, 1Pe 1:13, 2Pe 3:1, 1Jo 5:20; pl., Ef 2:3; in quotations from LXX, Mt 22:37, Mc 12:30, Lc 10:27, Hb 8:10 10:16 (Cremer, 79, 438).†
(AS)

G1272.def:
δι-αν-οίγω
[in LXX for פֶּטֶר (Ex, Nu), פָּקַח, פָּתַח, etc. ;]
to open up completely, to open: Lc 2:23 (LXX); pass., Mc 7:34, At 7:56. Metaphorical, δ. τ. νοῦν, Lc 24:45, τ. καρδίαν, At 16:14, pass., οἱ ὀφθαλμοί, Lc 24:31; of explaining, τ. γραφάς, Lc 24:32, At 17:3.†
(AS)

G1273.def:
δια-νυκτερεύω
(cf. διημερεύω, to pass the day) [in LXX: Jó 2:9 * ;]
to pass the night: before ἐν τ. προσευχῆ, Lc 6:12.†
(AS)

G1274.def:
δι-ανύω
[in LXX: 2Ma.12:17 * ;]
__1. to accomplish fully, finish, complete: At 21:7 (EV).
__2. In late writers (Xen., al., Clem., I ad Cor., xxv, 3), to continue: Ac, l.with (Field, Notes, 134f.).†
(AS)

G1276.def:
δια-περάω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Dt 30:13, Is 23:2 (עבר), עבר), 1Ma.6:1-63 * ;]
to pass over, cross over: Mt 9:1; before ἐπὶ τ. γῆν, Mt 14:34, Mc 6:53; εἰς, Mc 5:21, At 21:2; πρὸς ἡμᾶς, Lc 16:28.†
(AS)

G1277.def: to sail across , Thuc.; εἰς Αἴγιναν (Aristophanes Comicus): metaphorically, δ. βίον to make life's voyage , (Plato Philosophus) (ML)

G1278.def:
δια-πονέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Ec 10:9 (עָצַב ni.), 2Ma.2:28; in Aq.: Gn 6:6, 1Rs 20:3 * ;]
to work out with labour. Pass., to be worn out, sore troubled: Mc 14:4 (WH, mg.), At 4:2 16:18.†
(AS)

G1279.def:
δια-πορεύω
[in LXX for עָבַר, הָלַךְ, etc. ;]
to carry over. Pass., to pass across, journey through: absol., Lc 18:36, Rm 15:24; before κατὰ πόλεις κ. κώμας, Lc 13:22; διά, with genitive, Mc 2:23, Lc 6:1 (cf. Pv 9:12 with, Wis.3:1); with accusative, At 16:4.†
(AS)

G1280.def:
δι-απορέω, -ῶ
[in Sm.: Sl 77:5, Dn 2:1 * ;]
to be quite at a loss, be in great perplexity: absol., At 2:12; before διὰ τό, with inf., Lc 9:7; περί, At 5:24; ἐν ἑαυτῷ, At 10:17.†
(AS)

G1281.def:
δια-πραγματεύομαι , "perfective compound" (see M, Pr., 118);
__1. to examine thoroughly (Plat.).
__2. In late writers (Dion. Hal.), to gain by trading: Lc 19:15.†
(AS)

G1282.def:
δια-πρίω
[in LXX: 1Cr 20:3 (סוּר) * ;]
to saw asunder. Pass., metaphorically (vernacular?), EV, cut to the heart: At 5:33; before τ. καρδίαις αὐτῶν, At 7:54.†
(AS)

G1283.def:
δι-αρπάζω
[in LXX for בָּזַז, גָּזַל, שָׁסַס, etc. ;]
to plunder: Mt 12:29, Mc 3:27.†
(AS)

G1284.def:
δια-ρήσσω (so WH, exc. Ac, l.with), δια-ρρήσσω
(poetic and late form of διαρρήγνυμι), [in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;]
to break asunder, burst, rend: δεσμά, Lc 8:29; pass., δίκτυα, Lc 5:6; ἱμάτια, χιτῶνας, in grief or anger (as Gn 37:29, al.), Mt 26:65, At 14:14, Mc 14:63.†
(AS)

G1285.def:
δια-σαφέω, -ῶ
(σαφής, clear), [in LXX: Dt 1:5 (בָּאַר pi.), Dan LXX 2:6 (חָוָה aphel.), I-III Ma 9 * ;]
to make clear, explain fully: with accusative of thing(s), dative of person(s), Mt 13:26 18:31.†
(AS)

G1286.def:
δια-σείω
[in LXX: Jó 4:14 (פָּחַד hi.), 3Ma.7:21 * ;]
to shake violently; metaphorically, to intimidate: Lc 3:14.†
(AS)

G1287.def:
δια-σκορπίζω
[in LXX for פּוּץ, זָרָה, etc. ;]
to scatter abroad, disperse: of sheep, Mt 26:31 = Mc 14:27" (LXX) ; of persons, Lc 1:51, At 5:37, opposite to συνάγω, Jo 11:52; of winnowing grain, Mt 25:24, 26; metaphorically, of property, to squander, waste: Lc 15:13 16:1.†
(AS)

G1288.def:
δια-σπάω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for נָתַק, as Jz 16:9 ;]
to break or tear asunder: pass., ἁλύσεις, Mc 5:4; Παῦλος, At 23:10.†
(AS)

G1289.def:
δια-σπείρω
[frequently in LXX for פּוּץ, etc. ;]
to scatter abroad, disperse: At 8:1, 4 11:19.†
(AS)

G1290.def:
δια-σπορά, -ᾶς, ἡ
(διασπείρω), [in LXX of Israelites dispersed and exiled in foreign lands, as Dt 28:25 (זַעֲוָה) Dt 30:4 (נָדַח ni.), Is 49:6 (נער); by meton., of the exiles themselves (as Sl 147:2, 2Ma.1:27) ;]
a dispersion: δ. τῶν Ἑλλήνων, Jo 7:35; metaphorically, of Christians (DB, iii, 782 f.), Tg 1:1, 1Pe 1:1 (see Hort, in ll).†
(AS)

G1291.def:
δια-στελλω
[in LXX for בָּדַל hi. (Dt 10:8, al.), זְהַר hi. (Eze.3:18-19, al.), and 19 other words]
__1. to divide, distinguish, define.
__2. to command, charge expressly: pass., τὸ διαστελλόμενον, Hb 12:20. Mid., in late Gk. with same sense (so Ez, l.with; and al. in LXX; MM, see word); a. dative of person(s), Mc 8:15, At 15:24; before ἵνα, Mt 16:20, Mc 5:43 7:36 9:9.†
(AS)

G1292.def:
διάστημα, -τος, τό
(διίστημι), [in LXX for רֶוַח, etc. ;]
an interval, space: of time (Sir, prol. 24), At 5:7.†
(AS)

G1293.def:
δια-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(διαστέλλω), [in LXX for פְּדוּת: Êx 8:23, etc. ;]
__1. a separation.
__2. a distinction, difference: Rm 3:22 10:12, 1Co 14:7.†
(AS)

G1294.def:
δια-στρέφω
[in LXX for הָפַךְ, עָקַשׁ, etc. ;]
to distort, twist; metaphorically, to distort, pervert: Lc 23:2, At 13:8, 10; διεστραμμένος, perverse: Mt 17:17, Lc 9:41, At 20:30, Fp 2:15.†
(AS)

G1295.def:
δια-σώζω
[in LXX for מָלַט, יָשַׁע, etc. ;]
to bring safely through a danger: Lc 7:3, At 27:43; before πρός, At 23:24. Pass., to come safe through: At 28:1; ἐπὶ τ. γῆν, At 27:44; ἐκ τ. θαλάσσης, At 28:4; δι᾽ ὕδατος, 1Pe 3:20; of sickness, to recover: Mt 14:36.†
(AS)

G1296.def:
δια-ταγή, -ῆς, ἡ
(διατάσσω), [in LXX: Et 4:11 (פַּרְשֶׁגֶן)* ;]
in late writers (Deiss., LAE, 86 ff.) for cl. διάταξις (WH., however, is found in LXX, Sl 119:91, al.);
__(a) disposition (cf. διάταξις for צָבָא; Sm., 4Ki.23:4, Jr 8:2 19:13); εἰς διαταγὰς ἀγγέλων, AV, by the disposition of angels (Alf., in l, Field, Notes, 116; but see infr.): At 7:53;
__(b) ordinance (C. I. 3465): Rm 13:2, At 7:53, R, txt. (and see mg.; Page and EGT, in l; but also see supr.).†
(AS)

G1297.def:
διά-ταγμα, -τος, τό
(διατάσσω), [in LXX: Et 7:11 (נִשְׁתְּוָן), Et 3:13, Wis.11:7 * ;]
an edict, mandate: Hb 11:23.†
(AS)

G1299.def:
δια-τάσσω
[in LXX for שׂוּם, שָׁמַר, etc. ;]
to charge, give orders to, appoint, arrange, ordain: with dative, Mt 11:1, 1Co 9:14 16:1; before inf., Lc 8:55, At 18:2. Mid., 1Co 7:17, At 20:13; with accusative, 1Co 11:34; with dative, Tt 1:5; before inf., At 7:44 24:23. Pass., τὸ διατεταγμένον, Lc 3:13, At 23:31; τὰ διαταχθέντα, Lc 17:9-10; διαταγείς, Gl 3:19.†
(AS)
